name: Detección de Ráfagas
description: Analiza the explosividad patrones en texto to distinguish generado por IA from escrito por humanos content.
useCase: Detecting AI text through análisis of longitud de oración and complexity variation
mechanism: Mide the variation (explosividad) in sentence structures, lengths, and complexity throughout a text. Human writing naturally varies entre simple and complex sentences, short and long paragraphs. generado por IA text tends to maintain a more uniform level of complexity, resulting in lower explosividad scores.
source: Guo et al. (2023) - How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection, arXiv
algorithm: Sentence Length Variance + Structural Complexity Scoring + Moving Window Analysis
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: 5 sentences, Metrics: length varianza, complexity index, transition entropía
strengths:
• Métrica simple e interpretable
• Independiente del idioma en cierta medida
• Funciona bien combinado con otros métodos de texto
• Cálculo rápido en cualquier longitud de texto
limitations:
• Lower precisión as standalone detector
• Academic and technical writing naturally has low explosividad
• AI models are improving at mimicking human variability
• Very short texts are unreliable

references.title: Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? arXiv.
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
Tulchinskii, E. et al. (2024). Intrinsic Dimension Estimation for Robust Detection of AI-Generated Texts. NeurIPS.
